name: 07822 · Augusta, NJ
findings: ZIP 07822 (Augusta) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07822 (Augusta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07822 (Augusta) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 10.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
